recognize_zh: 骨髓切片高倍中多顆大型組織球具有大量粉紅色、條紋狀像皺摺紙張的細胞質，核小而偏心，周圍為密集的顆粒球系細胞，是 CML 常見的假性高雪氏細胞。
features: Large histiocytes with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm showing fibrillary, crumpled striations
Small eccentric round nuclei, some with small vacuoles in the cytoplasm
Histiocytes form loose clusters among hematopoietic cells
Background granulocytic cells including segmented neutrophils and myeloid precursors
Occasional larger hyperchromatic cells in the lower left corner
describe_en: High-power view of the bone marrow trephine biopsy shows clusters of large histiocytes with abundant eosinophilic, fibrillary cytoplasm resembling crumpled tissue paper and small eccentric nuclei. The surrounding marrow is densely populated by granulocytic precursors and maturing neutrophils. No organisms or granulomas are seen. In the setting of BCR::ABL1-positive disease, findings are consistent with pseudo-Gaucher cells in chronic myeloid leukemia.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells look identical but occur without a myeloproliferative background and are confirmed by glucocerebrosidase deficiency.
Mycobacteria-laden histiocytes may appear striated but are Ziehl-Neelsen positive.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain coarse ceroid granules that are blue on Romanowsky stains rather than fibrillary pink cytoplasm on H&E.
